title: PerfectScalarMonoidalFunctor
statement: The fixed derived scalar functor restricted to perfect source objects is strong monoidal with the recorded balanced tensor and unit maps as inverse tensorators. A perfect-valued strong monoidal functor lifts to the full perfect subcategory.

source.place: Final paragraph: rationalization and the common-stage coefficient construction; the following explicit conditional argument is agent-written.

proof.text: The normalized coherence data supplies closure of perfect objects under tensor and unit. Its tensor naturality, associativity and unit equations give an oplax monoidal functor. The tensor and unit maps are isomorphisms, so CoreMonoidal.ofOplaxMonoidal gives the strong structure. Full-subcategory lifting preserves the integral core equations by faithful inclusion. Compose the lifted integral and perfect scalar oplax functors, and apply the same existing constructor to obtain the named composite core.
